Cognee founder: 'We have temporal resolution mechanisms we are building... cognee has notion of nodesets which work similar to tags... we have graphs per user now available. So, user permissions + graph filtering.'
Founders claim Cognee builds memory combining graph, vector, and relational stores, extracting entities and connections, and reached almost 90% on standard industry benchmarks.
Founders state that testing on HotpotQA with human labeling achieved 87% answer accuracy using Cognee's ECL pipeline approach with FalkorDB integration.

After weeks reading about Cognee, Graphiti, and Neo4j's agent-memory architectures, a user found they 'converged on the same heavy knowledge-graph design' requiring ontology, LLM extraction pipelines, and deduplication - calling it 'such a heavy setup that adds a lot of friction and silos' for personal use cases.

User opted against using Cognee/Graphiti/Zep for personal long-term memory, instead using Obsidian, Readwise, and Google Drive with per-project LLM wikis, stating 'you can build the same knowledge graph experience via plain old .md files' without the infrastructure overhead.
Community response to Cognee's Show HN launch was brief and positive: 'Good luck guys looks great.'
